Neo Universe might "disappear" in the 
future. —What could that disappearance 
possibly mean?

Zenno Rob Roy proposes a hypothesis: 
"Observing another universe through 
something... might be interfering and 
making it difficult to see."

To prevent Neo Universe's "disappearance," 
next year would be an especially crucial 
time. Her Trainer became deeply convinced 
of this.
